code.description: Coupon code used at checkout to apply the discount.

amount.description: Discount value as a fixed amount or percentage depending on discount type.

date_created.description: Date and time the coupon was created, in the site's local timezone.

date_created_gmt.description: Date and time the coupon was created, in GMT.

date_modified.description: Date and time the coupon was last modified, in the site's local timezone.

date_modified_gmt.description: Date and time the coupon was last modified, in GMT.

discount_type.description: Type of discount, such as percent, fixed_cart, or fixed_product.

description.description: Optional description providing internal details or notes about the coupon.

date_expires.description: Expiration date and time for the coupon in the site's local timezone, or null if it does not expire.

date_expires_gmt.description: Expiration date and time for the coupon in GMT, or null if it does not expire.

usage_count.description: Total number of times the coupon has been used.

individual_use.description: Whether the coupon cannot be used in conjunction with other coupons.

items.description: Product ID eligible for the discount.

product_ids.description: List of product IDs that the coupon applies to.

items.description: Product ID ineligible for the discount.

excluded_product_ids.description: List of product IDs that cannot receive the coupon discount.

usage_limit.description: Maximum number of times the coupon can be used across all customers, or null for unlimited.

usage_limit_per_user.description: Maximum number of times a single customer can use the coupon, or null for unlimited.

limit_usage_to_x_items.description: Maximum number of qualifying items the coupon discount can apply to in an order, or null for unlimited.

free_shipping.description: Whether applying the coupon grants free shipping.

items.description: Category ID eligible for the coupon discount.

product_categories.description: List of product category IDs that the coupon applies to.

items.description: Category ID ineligible for the coupon discount.

excluded_product_categories.description: List of product category IDs excluded from receiving the coupon discount.

exclude_sale_items.description: Whether items already on sale are excluded from the coupon discount.

minimum_amount.description: Minimum subtotal required in the cart to apply the coupon.

maximum_amount.description: Maximum allowed subtotal in the cart for the coupon to be valid.

items.description: Email address authorized to redeem the coupon.

email_restrictions.description: List of customer billing email addresses permitted to use the coupon.

items.description: Identifier or email of a customer who redeemed the coupon.

used_by.description: List of user IDs or email addresses of customers who have used the coupon.

items.description: A single metadata entry with an ID, key, and value.

meta_data.description: Custom metadata key-value pairs associated with the coupon.

_links.description: HATEOAS navigational links related to the coupon resource.

items.description: A coupon entity containing discount rules and usage conditions.

description: List of coupons matching the request parameters.
